raw_text: Northeast Now reports widespread protests across Assam and Tripura against CAA implementation. Bandh supporters have blocked National Highway 27 at multiple points and halted train services at Guwahati, Kamakhya, and Dibrugarh stations. Social media monitoring shows coordinated messaging patterns across dozens of Telegram groups in the region.
clean_text: Widespread anti-CAA protests in Assam and Tripura. NH-27 blocked at multiple points, train services halted. Coordinated messaging detected across dozens of regional Telegram groups.
